title: Three-layer radome wall: fibreglass skins and a syntactic foam core
source: V. S. Anshin, A. A. Politiko, V. A. Dyakonov, A. V. Pyzanov, 2024 IEEE 9th All-Russian Microwave Conf. (RMC), pp. 256-260, Figs. 3-5
notes: Fig. 3: skins eps = 3.1 - j0.05, about 1.8 mm; core (syntactic foam, 230 kg/m3) eps = 1.37 - j0.01, about 6.9 mm; total about 10.5 mm; free space on both sides. The paper uses exp(+jwt) (eps' - j eps''), converted here. Fig. 4 is 'parallel (E)' polarisation, E in the plane of incidence: p here. Fig. 5 is 'perpendicular (H)': s here (the dips deepen with angle, as for s). The thicknesses are given as approximate, and the paper states its measured and calculated curves agree within 0.2 dB.
